turns.text: We run an online store in Southeast Asia with about 30,000 daily users and big sales peaks. Design a highly available web architecture.

I'll design a highly available two-zone web store in Singapore, fronted by ESA and ALB with WAF, ECS behind Auto Scaling for sales peaks, Tair cache and RDS.
Sessions go to Tair and orders to RDS, both deployed across two zones for resilience.
